title: Family Service Centres with Dedicated Headcount for Community Work
what_it_is: Family Service Centres with Dedicated Headcount for Community Work

sections.label: MSF funding for FSC community work
sections.summary: A Member asks whether MSF can study how to help FSC social workers do more community work, and MSF states it funds FSCs for casework, group work and community work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: So, could I ask whether MSF can look into this further and study how we can help FSCs social workers do more community work?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I think for the benefit of everyone who is in Parliament, I would like to share and clarify that MSF provides funding to the FSCs for casework, group work and community work.

sections.label: MSF funding basis for FSCs
sections.summary: MSF funds FSCs by number of cases managed, plus two fixed headcounts for group and community work and five for administrative and corporate functions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Right now, MSF funds the FSCs based on the actual number of cases managed, so MSF funds casework funding.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The MSF funds two fixed headcount to carry out group work and community work and five other fixed headcounts for administrative and corporate functions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As to how the FSC wants to internally allocate work and the funding within the FSC, that is not something that MSF intervenes in, and it may change from FSC to FSC.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But I would just like to assure the Member that we are fully supportive of what the FSCs are doing for individuals, families and the community, and our funding approach takes into account, as I mentioned, casework, group work and community work.

sections.label: FSC allocation of work and funding
sections.summary: MSF has different funding principles for casework, group work and community work, while each FSC decides how to allocate work and funding internally.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: And that is why I have taken some care to share that our support for FSC spans casework, group work and community work.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We have different funding principles for the three categories.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But depending on what the FSC sees as the needs in the community, the FSC may determine within themselves how to allocate work between the different functions and also to allocate the funding within the FSC.
